name: The Shield
description: Defensive contributions are worth 10 points instead of 2. One player per club, six players, unlimited budget.
_scoring_note: Restates the points only. The bar for earning them is unchanged, because neither source mentions it: 10 defensive actions for defenders, 12 for midfielders and forwards. Keepers stay at 0 because they never earn defensive contribution in FPL, and base_scoring already has GKP 0.
source: https://fplchallenge.premierleague.com/ home page, read 2026-09-18: "Gameweek 5 Challenge - The Shield - Defensive Contributions score 10 points. One player per club." Same challenge in https://www.premierleague.com/en/news/4683622/fpl-challenge-is-live-for-202627-see-the-first-five-challenges: "defensive contributions are worth 10 points, rather than the usual two per player."
